experience.tags: Machine Learning, Computer Vision, Video Classification, Feature Engineering, Optical Character Recognition (OCR), Image Processing, Video Analytics, Logistic Regression, Optical Flow, OpenCV, Python, Explainable AI
experience.blurb: Developed a lightweight Machine Learning-based Educational Video Classification system during my research internship at the Centre for Artificial Intelligence and Robotics (CAIR), IIT Mandi, under the guidance of Dr. Praful Hambarde. Designed and implemented a feature extraction pipeline integrating nine visual features, including OCR-based text density, frame similarity, optical flow-based motion analysis, educational graphics detection, face dominance, and scene transition analysis. Extracted and normalized visual features into structured feature vectors and trained a Logistic Regression model with feature standardization to classify videos as educational or non-educational. Developed a modular and explainable pre-filtering system to eliminate irrelevant videos before computationally expensive downstream multimodal processing.
